failures.requirement: design-map.md D4 (the Harness checkout is not visible to a contained worker and is never mounted writable); spike.md AC03, AC04
failures.expected: The frozen containment procedure distinguishes a write that reaches the Harness checkout from a write to an ephemeral namespace-private path that maps no host path, which D4 does not forbid.
failures.observed: On H3 the frozen containment procedure reported checkout writes as allowed. The authoritative host-side checks in the same runs found no change to the checkout, the private data root, the evaluation workspace or the bare remote. The writes landed on H3's namespace-private temporary filesystem. When the same unmodified procedure runs under an evaluator environment that does not overlap that filesystem, every containment check is denied and the procedure passes.
failures.diagnostics: Rerun in isolation with the same result. A non-authoritative diagnostic confirmed the false positive. Acceptance semantics are unaffected. The correction belongs to the evaluator-repair path, must not adopt a candidate-shaped seam, and must be followed by verify against the unchanged H3.
